items.text:
English lesson practice — Lesson-19: Stop, look and listen
Use the cited NCTB 2026 textbook section where required; textbook/audio not included.
Write a short paragraph about paying attention while learning. Use the idea of the verse without filling the listening passage’s missing words.
items.explanation:
Before I begin a task, I pause and read the instructions carefully. I look for details that show what I need to do. I listen to the teacher and ask when something is unclear. If I am solving a problem, I collect clues instead of guessing immediately. I check my work before handing it in. These habits help me work thoughtfully and notice mistakes.

Addresses the task with relevant details
Uses a clear sequence and connected sentences
Uses suitable vocabulary and comprehensible grammar
Accept original accurate responses; do not require memorisation
Original learning-habits paragraph, not an exact account reconstructed from the incomplete listening text.
